description: Updates a drop title, channel preset, hook line, or card slide text. Use when the user wants to change drop display title, default export channel, or edit the hook or slides. For new AI copy use regenerate_drop_copy.

channel_preset.description: Social format. Sets aspect ratio, length and copy style. Clip posts: ig_reels, ig_stories, ig_carousel (Instagram square video), tiktok, yt_shorts, fb_reels, yt_longform, fb_post, linkedin_post, threads_post. Card posts: ig_post, ig_stories, fb_post, linkedin_post, threads_post. Sets the post's default channel. With hook, picks which channel's copy changes. Example: "ig_reels".

drop_id.description: Drop (social post) ID from list_team_drops or create_drop.

hook.description: New opening line (hook) of the copy for channel_preset, or for the post's current channel. Other copy stays.

slides.description: Card posts only: the full slide text, 1 to 10 slides in order. Changed slides are re-rendered.

alt_text.description: Image alt text for screen readers, up to 200 characters.

body.description: Slide body text, up to 220 characters.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

title.description: New post title shown in Teams and exports. "" clears it back to the source name.

name: update_drop
title: Update drop
